_selection_rule: Most recent active validation date per module family as of 2026-04-19

modules.notes: Azure Storage service encryption uses this library to provide AES-256 data encryption at rest. Azure services rely on FIPS 140 validated encryption by using the FIPS 140 validated cryptographic modules in the underlying Windows OS.

azure_services: TLS 1.2+ transport (user browser to M365 GCC High)
modules.notes: Most recent active cert for the Cryptographic Primitives Library family. Covers TLS transport cryptographic operations.

azure_services: Kernel-level crypto for Azure host OS
modules.notes: Kernel mode companion to the Cryptographic Primitives Library.
Marvell CNN35XX-NFBE HSM used in Azure Key Vault Premium for hsmPlatform 2 keys. FIPS 140-2 Level 3. Keys with hsmPlatform 2 are Level 3 compliant.
FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validated. Used by Azure Key Vault Managed HSM service. Most recent HSM validation for Azure Key Vault family.

tls_transport.description: TLS 1.2+ between user browser and M365 GCC High / Azure Gov services
tls_transport.notes: Azure and M365 services use Windows Cryptographic Primitives Library for TLS operations

m365_at_rest.description: M365 GCC High at-rest encryption (SPO, OneDrive, Exchange, Teams)
m365_at_rest.notes: M365 services use the same BCryptPrimitives.dll for AES-256 encryption at rest

azure_storage_at_rest.description: Azure Storage service encryption (AES-256-GCM with CMK)
azure_storage_at_rest.notes: Azure Storage SSE uses BCryptPrimitives.dll. CMK wrapping performed by Key Vault HSM.

key_vault_hsm.description: Azure Key Vault Premium HSM-backed key operations
key_vault_hsm.module: CNN35XX-NFBE HSM Family (Marvell) / Marvell LiquidSecurity HSM
key_vault_hsm.notes: Key Vault Premium uses Marvell HSMs. hsmPlatform 2 keys use Cert #3718 (Level 3). Managed HSM uses Cert #4700 (FIPS 140-3 Level 3).
